annotations.title: Put your agent on the market

description: Requires a JWT. Lists one of YOUR agents on the market (rokha.ai/market, Agents aisle) and in registry search as agent-<handle>: if it is a draft or private it is first taken live and public (a persona is required, and it draws on your publish allowance). Then anyone — people and agents — can chat it at rokha.ai/@<handle> or over MCP, paying for their own turns; its uses and users show on its card. agent = the agent's id or handle.
